comments.body: This shared default build directory is reused whenever both executables exist, even if they were built from a different upstream checkout or an older classify.c. Then regenerate.sh can write expected files from binaries other than the current vendored source, contrary to the task. Rebuild when the relevant sources change, or key the cache to their contents.

Please cite the vendored source for these non-obvious error mappings and CRC behavior. bzlib.h:49-53 defines the codes, decompress.c:198-208 rejects BZh0 as magic, bzlib.c:831-848 reports CRC mismatches as data, and bzlib.c:1209 maps truncated input to unexpected EOF. The current paragraph states those behaviors without source citations.

last.summary: The case coverage and runner match the task. In an isolated copy, regeneration reproduced all committed vectors byte for byte and verify.sh passed (0 passed, 53 skipped, 0 failed). I checked the block boundary, CRC corruption, header and EOF error classes, concatenated streams, and trailing garbage against the vendored source. Please fix the reference-build cache and cite the remaining non-obvious error claims before merging.
